raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Accenture India Pvt. Ltd | Oct’21 - Present
Client: Barclays
Lead Business Analyst
Owned product discovery, roadmap & scope definition while leading business analysis for
the migration of European customers to a new regulated entity

Impact Assessment: Led impact assessments across multiple workstreams within the
issuing business of the entity to understand the impact of migration & cross-workstream dependency mapping.

Workshop Facilitation: Facilitated stakeholder workshops to establish product scope,
align strategic priorities, & secure stakeholder buy-in.

External Stakeholder Collaboration: Partnered with major card payment schemes to coordinate licensing requirements, enabling seamless transition for the new entity.
Backlog Management: Reduced requirement ambiguity by ~30–40% through structured workshops, backlog refinement, prioritised user stories and clearly defined acceptance criteria.

Spearheaded end-to-end execution of automated refund process for CHAPS & SWIFT payment methods, achieving a ~60–70% reduction in manual effort.

Workflow Optimisation: Improved processing throughput by 40–50% and minimised

operational errors through defined business rules, automated validation controls and workflow optimisation.
Cards & Payments / Corporate Cards: Worked hands-on on UK and European Cards & Payments programmes,
with strong exposure to Corporate Card issuing, card lifecycle, payment processing and related business processes for Barclays.
• Visa/Mastercard Scheme & Regulatory Changes: Worked with card payment schemes including Visa/Mastercard
on scheme requirements, regulatory changes and implementation activities, assessing business and system impact across the card-issuing environment.
Regulatory Change & Implementation: Analysed regulatory and scheme requirements and translated them into
business requirements, process changes and system enhancements, supporting implementation across UK and European markets.
AML & Compliance: Worked hands-on with AML and regulatory compliance requirements within banking/card
programmes, collaborating with business, compliance and technology stakeholders to ensure requirements were incorporated into the solution.
Risk & Control Assessment: Performed risk and impact assessments for regulatory and business changes, identifying process/control gaps, assessing downstream impacts and defining remediation requirements.
Regulatory Control Framework: Supported the definition and implementation of regulatory controls across
card/payment processes, ensuring business rules, system workflows and operational processes remained aligned with applicable regulatory requirements.
UAT & Compliance Validation: Led/coordinated SIT/UAT, defect management, business validation and sign-off
for regulatory and card-payment changes, ensuring implemented requirements met business, compliance and scheme expectations.
Regulatory Traceability: Maintained requirement traceability from regulatory/scheme requirements through
functional requirements, development, testing and UAT sign-off, ensuring complete implementation coverage.
UK & Europe Regulatory Rollout: Supported country/market-specific implementation of regulatory and card-
payment changes across UK and European markets, coordinating dependencies across business, technology, compliance and testing teams.
Delivery Governance: Translated business goals into actionable epics, wireframes, and acceptance criteria
(DoD/DoR), preventing scope creep and reducing development rework.

Team Alignment: Collaborated with Solution Architects to validate design against business requirements and guided Scrum squads during sprint delivery to align technical implementation with roadmap goals.

Contributed as a Business Analyst to build a centralised customer data platform for the Big Three PSUs

Functional Logic Modelling: Defined deduplication logic to identify duplicate customers;
Reduced revenue leakage and improved subsidy governance.
Requirements Articulation: Conducted in-person and virtual workshops with cross-functional stakeholders,
authoring comprehensive BRD & FRD documentation with clear functional specifications.
Data Mapping & API Design: Supported data mapping activities and defined API request/response structures.

Participated as a Business Analyst in developing a Product/Process Licensing platform for a Medical and Healthcare Regulatory agency.

End-to-End Journey & Workflow Design: Supported in defining the end-to-end application
journey; Designed workflows for submission, validation, and status tracking of applications. System Integration: Ensured integration of the application submission with backend approval systems
Meditab India Pvt. Ltd | Jan’21 - Sept’21
Product Analyst

Owned the EHR system enhancement and feature delivery for lab modules and seamless HL7 integrations
•
Managed end-to-end backlog grooming and sprint planning, establishing clear Definition of Ready (DoR) standards
Led User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sign-offs & defect triage to ensure high product quality
Softweb Solutions Pvt. Ltd | Jun’16 - Jan’21
Business Analyst (Presales/Postsales)

Worked as a BA on various enterprise application projects, understanding & translating business needs into clear & actionable requirements.
•
Created user stories, wireframes, and process flows.
Supported pre-sales activities such as use case feasibility analysis, solutioning & WBS.

Contributed to product ideation & implementation strategies, particularly in IoT; conducted market research & competitive analysis for informed decision-making.
Early career

Ace Infoways: Worked as Business Analyst (Aug’15 - Feb’16)
Hitech Outsourcing: Worked as Programmer Analyst (.NET & SQL) (Nov’11 - Aug’12)
